netlist:
cmos_meyer_tran
Vdd supply 0 5
Vin in 0 DC 0 PULSE(0 5 1n 1n 1n 20n 42n)
Mn out in 0 0 nf W=10u L=1u
Mp out in supply supply pf W=20u L=1u
Cload out 0 1p
.model nf NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=1 KP=200u LAMBDA=.02 CGSO=100p CGDO=100p TOX=20n)
.model pf PMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=-1 KP=100u LAMBDA=.02 CGSO=100p CGDO=100p TOX=20n)
.options reltol=1e-6 vntol=1e-9
.tran 20p 40n
.control
set numdgt=15
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
run
let value0 = v(out)
wrdata reference.dat value0
quit
.endc
.end
